inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.google.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/google. Only `credential`, a compact JWT of at most 4096 characters, and `csrf`, 32 to 128 base64url characters, are read; other keys are dropped, and a missing or malformed one throws `invalid-request` before the challenge is consumed.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeStart.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/native/start. It reads `challenge` (exactly 43 base64url characters, the S256 hash of the desktop's PKCE verifier), `nonce` (22 to 128 URL-safe characters) and `resource` (`projects` or `project:<projectId>`); other keys are dropped, and a malformed field throws `invalid-request`.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeApprove.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/native/approve, sent by the signed-in browser, with `handoffId` (32 to 128 base64url characters) and `userCode`. Only the first 32 characters of `userCode` are read, then upper-cased with every character outside A-Z and 0-9 removed, so dashes and spaces drop out; the result must be 8 characters from the code alphabet, which excludes I, O, 0 and 1.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativePoll.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/native/poll. Only `handoffId`, 32 to 128 base64url characters, is read and other keys are dropped; a missing or malformed `handoffId` throws `invalid-request` before the handoff is looked up.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeExchange.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/native/exchange. It reads `handoffId` (32 to 128 base64url characters), `verifier` (43 to 128 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `.`, `_`, `~` and `-`, the PKCE verifier the desktop kept), `nonce` (22 to 128 URL-safe characters) and `resource` (`projects` or `project:<projectId>`); other keys are dropped, and a malformed field throws `invalid-request` before the handoff is claimed.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.githubCallback.url
inputs.description: The request URL of GET /api/github/callback, passed in as `new URL(request.url)`; only its `code` and `state` search parameters are read. A missing or malformed parameter makes the validator return null instead of throwing.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.emailCode.body
inputs.description: The parsed JSON body of POST /api/auth/email/verify, read only for `code`. Only the first 32 characters of `code` are read, spaces and dashes are removed, and what remains must be exactly 8 decimal digits; other keys are dropped, and a non-string or wrong `code` throws `invalid-request`.

inputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.repositoryId.value
inputs.description: The raw value to check as a GitHub repository id, of any JSON type. It is accepted only when it is a JavaScript number that is a safe integer and greater than zero; anything else throws `invalid-request`.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.google
outputs.description: The typed Google sign-in input: `credential` is the compact Google ID token exactly as sent, and `csrf` is the challenge token that POST /api/auth/challenge issued. Both have passed their checks, but the token has not yet been verified with Google.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeStart
outputs.description: The typed native start input: `challenge` and `nonce` exactly as sent, and `resource` as `projects` or `project:<projectId>`. The handoff service stores `challenge` and `resource` as given and keeps only a hash of `nonce`.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeApprove
outputs.description: The typed approval input: `handoffId` exactly as sent, and `userCode` normalized to 8 characters from the code alphabet with no dash. Dashes, spaces and lower case in the typed code are accepted because normalization runs before the check.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativePoll
outputs.description: The `handoffId` read from the poll body, returned unchanged. The validator does not look the handoff up; the poll call does that next.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.nativeExchange
outputs.description: The typed exchange input: `handoffId`, `verifier`, `nonce` and `resource`, each exactly as sent. The validator does not compare them with the stored handoff; the exchange does that after it claims the handoff.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.githubCallback
outputs.description: The `code` and `state` query values, both returned unchanged, or `null` when either is missing or malformed, such as when GitHub reports a refusal instead of a code. A `code` is 1 to 200 letters, digits, `_` or `-`, and a `state` is 32 to 128 base64url characters.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.emailCode
outputs.description: The eight decimal digits the person typed, with spaces and dashes removed and leading zeros kept. The value has not yet been checked against the code that was sent.

outputs.name: AuthRequestValidator.repositoryId
outputs.description: The GitHub repository id, returned unchanged once it is a JavaScript number that is a safe integer greater than zero. It is the same kind of value as the `repositoryId` that `HubAuth.authorizeRepository` takes.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Thrown through `authFail('invalid-request')`, which gives HTTP status 400 and the message `Hub auth invalid-request`, when a required field is missing or fails its pattern or length limit, or when a repository id is not a positive safe integer. This validator throws no other AuthFailure code.
